name: Sakiba Suguru
source: The protagonist. A second year student who was attending Yumemigafuchi high school. He is a pervert and is the president of his own occult research club. He wishes to summon a succubus one day so that he can have his sexual desires fulfilled. Every day he attempts to summon a succubus, even forcing his [url=/c94620]childhood friend[/url] to cooperate with him. One day, during another failed summoning he ends up transporting to the country of succubus in Yggdrasil along with Mako. With new erotic powers and a magic spell book, he is ready to conquer the succubus school.
